test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 8 Feb 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is 'knowledge'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given blank needs a noun to describe the know-how of girls regarding domestic affairs. 
 
• For this purpose, the correct noun is knowledge. 
 
• **Knowledge **means **facts, information, and skills acquired through experience or education.**
 
• Thus, option 2 is the correct answer. 

 

*Correct passage__ - **As the education of girls becomes similar (1) to that of boys, their home life will also become similar. Their present greater (2) __knowledg__e of domestic affairs will also disappear. After a (3) certain age, boys and girls should have a share in parental occupations and (4) anxieties, but not in excess as it would interfere with their education. Yet, (5) awareness of the problems of adult life helps boys and girls understand and appreciate the efforts of their parents.*
